cold_filter.set_port: one sticky SET signal from successful row-install commit; concurrent same-value SET is idempotent, no read-modify-write counter
cold_filter.reset: cache/directory construction only; never at reclaim/rollback/WB completion/epoch/flush
cold_filter.read_path: one negative proof read alongside existing Tag miss stage on the single serialized frontend; max one request check per physical cache cycle; no associative lookup/ticket generated while cold
cold_filter.cycle_cost: folded small gate into existing Tag stage; no separate CAM query is launched; the added wire/logic is NOT physically closed and not claimed free or 0ns
cold_filter.timing_failure: if gate cannot meet the existing Tag-stage timing, insert an explicit stage; a one-cycle serial gate can erase latency benefit versus one-cycle baseline query; do not suppress cost
cold_filter.invariant: never_installed implies occupied==0 by induction over all production insertion paths; first successful install sets sticky before visible row; dirty promotion requires an already existing source row
cold_filter.qualification: default-off/clean/dirty partition; failed commit/pin/mandatory/stale/rollback/lower backing proof; no full app acceptance

retention_model.chosen_policy: unified LRU across reclaimable CLEAN and WB_COMPLETE, same-bank only; no completed-WB priority over more-recent CLEAN
retention_model.existing_metadata: production entry age is uint64_t per 128 rows (8192 bits logical age metadata); not a new free counter/array; hardware compression/ranking unresolved
retention_model.selector: one existing-or-budgeted control row-read lane, one 64bit age comparator, sequential 1 row per cycle; 128 rows require128 scan cycles
retention_model.new_pending_metadata: one selected index/incarnation/age + scan cursor/bank/phase, about148 logical bits excluding reuse of existing clock enable; simulator64bit timestamps not asserted hardware area
retention_model.commit: one distinct shared row-update lane cycle after complete scan, live incarnation/status/readers/age recheck; blocks on any busy lane; no lower enqueue without allocator/credit pre-reservation
not_implemented: atomic allocator release and mandatory WB producer integration
